name: io.github.IronSecCo/ironclaw

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your running IronClaw control-plane, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8787. This image is a thin client with no host privilege: it delegates every sandbox_exec run to the control-plane, which owns the hardened gVisor launch. Unset means no backend and the tool fails closed.
environmentVariables.name: IRONCLAW_CONTROLPLANE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the control-plane API (the value the control-plane was started with).
environmentVariables.name: IRONCLAW_API_TOKEN
